{{Top|leg}}
'''Photosynthesis''' was a natural process by which [[Plant/Legends|plants]] gained sustenance. The [[Neti/Legends|Neti]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] plant-like [[Species/Legends|species]], survived by this manner.<ref name="Essential Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] {{C|Neti (Ryyk)}}</ref>

Forest [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony world, had broad [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] fronds that grew in the [[Color/Legends|reddish]] light of the planet's [[Koth'lar|star]], maintaining Kothlis' Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] through a crude form of photosynthesis. This process lent an odd fragrance to the planet's air smelling something like warm and moldy [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
